purpose: Per-URL record of real content changes (SG-07). A page's lastmod changes ONLY when that page's content, key links, or structured facts change — build changes, unrelated commits, and date-only edits never bump it. frontend/functions/[[path]].js (STATIC_SITEMAP_ENTRIES) and frontend/public/sitemap.xml mirror this file; tests assert the three stay in sync. Update the manifest, the functions mirror, and the static sitemap together in the same change.

provenance.2026-09-05: Inherited from the pre-manifest blanket date (2026-09-05 site-wide update). Replace with the page's true content-change date next time that page actually changes; do not bulk-edit.
provenance.2026-09-08: Real content change made on 2026-09-08: GitLab claims removed, unsupported performance claims rewritten (SG-02), curated-compare body unified (SG-01), /extension page added (SG-03).

comparePages.note: The curated /compare/* template (summary, table, FAQ, evidence links) changed on 2026-09-08 with the SG-01 view-model refactor, so every curated comparison page's rendered content changed that day.
